description: This Java class defines an Akka HTTP route for the '/status' endpoint, providing overall status, health, and cluster information. It constructs HTTP responses based on cluster status and health provider data, secured with devOps authentication.

classes.name: OverallStatusRoute
classes.description: Defines Akka HTTP routes for '/status' related endpoints, providing overall status, health, and cluster information secured with DevOps authentication.

methods.name: buildOverallStatusRoute
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Akka HTTP Route for '/status' endpoints, handling '/status', '/status/health', and '/status/cluster'.

methods.name: createOverallStatusResponse
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves overall status from the provider and creates an HTTP response with status 200.

methods.name: createOverallHealthResponse
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves overall health, returning HTTP 200 if healthy, or HTTP 503 if not, with JSON entity.
